title: Rat Queens #15 #16 Lot Image Shadowline 2016 Kurtis Wiebe Tess Fowler Mature
conditionDescription: Both bright and clean with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Rat Queens #15 and #16 (March - April 2016), Image Comics / Shadowline - the last two issues of Tess Fowler's run (#11-16). Kurtis J. Wiebe story, Tess Fowler art, Tamra Bonvillain colors, Ed Brisson letters. Rated M / Mature. $3.99 cover price each.

- #15: broken-shield cover. Back cover: Rat Queens Volume Three: Demons preview
- #16: "When Beards Collide" - Fowler and Bonvillain group cover. Back cover: next issue #17 preview

Condition: both bright and clean with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
